findings.desc: concept-cleanup: new command verification_pin_guard_check was added to command-policy.ts (readOnly gate for the B-1507 evidence-pin hook) but has NO entry in process-fact-levels.ts PROCESS_FACT_LEVELS. packages/main/src/tasks/lifecycle-registry-contract.ts checkProcessFactLifecycle() asserts every command-policy command has a process-fact level entry; this contract task is registered in lattice.config.json validate.commands, i.e. it runs as part of lattice validate. Verified by direct execution: node packages/main/dist/tasks/lifecycle-registry-contract.js on this branch prints lifecycle-registry consistency: FAIL with [process-fact-lifecycle] command verification_pin_guard_check is in the registry command dimension (command-policy) but has no process-fact lifecycle level entry. Same task built from main PASSes with 0 divergences (main has no verification_pin_guard_check string in process-fact-levels.ts at all), confirming this is a regression introduced by this diff. verification_run (the other new command in this story) IS correctly present in process-fact-levels.ts/process-fact-registry.ts, and its sibling readOnly guard prewrite_guard_check IS present in process-fact-levels.ts at L0 -- so the omission is specific to verification_pin_guard_check. Fix: add a PROCESS_FACT_LEVELS entry for verification_pin_guard_check (e.g. level L0, category guard-session-read, matching the prewrite_guard_check precedent).
